items.text: REFERRED TO RACING, GAMING AND WAGERING

items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law and the tax
law, in relation to allowing Suffolk off-track betting corporations to host
video lottery gaming devices
items.lawCode: Amd §503, RWB L; amd §§1612 & 1617-a, Tax L
items.lawSection: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S6487

SPONSOR: GAUGHRAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and
breeding law and the tax law, in relation to allowing Suffolk off-track
betting corporations to host video lottery gaming devices

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

The purpose of this legislation is to allow the Suffolk regional off-
track betting corporation to install and operate up to 3,000 video
lottery gaming terminals.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Amends Section 503 of the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and
breeding law by adding a new subdivision 10-a.

Section 2: Amends subparagraph (ii) of paragraph 1 of subdivision b of
section 1612 of the tax law, as added by section 1 of part EE of chapter
59 of the laws of 2019.

Section 3: Amends paragraph 3 of subdivision a of section 1617-a of the
tax law, as added by section 1 of part SS of chapter 60 of the laws of
2016.

Section 4: Sets the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Under current New York State law, the Suffolk off-track betting corpo-
ration (OTB) is only permitted to install and operate up to 1,000 video
lottery gaming devices. The facility housing these devices has one of
the highest Win Per Unit (WPU) rates in both New York State and the
country, generating upwards of $100,000,000 in funding for State educa-
tion. This bill would give Suffolk OTB the ability to install and oper-
ate up to 3,000 video lottery gaming devices, which estimates show could
possibly generate over twice as much funding for State education while
also providing Suffolk County with an additional $15,000,000 to
$20,000,000 in much needed recurring annual revenue.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

No cost to the state. However, it is estimated that this act would
generate millions of dollars in revenue for both Suffolk County and the
state.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
The act shall take effect on the first of January next succeeding the
date on which it shall have become a law.

summary: Authorizes Suffolk regional off-track betting corporations to host video lottery gaming devices.
